digest.component_or_area: rebar-engine dispatch, llm eval, metrics registry
propositions: timeout_s parameter in _call_with_retry is declared but never used in function body, causing caller-provided timeout_s values to be swallowed instead of forwarded to wrapped fn
run_eval accepts dirty parameter but never reads it, falsely implying eval-provenance source can be switched
module_size_trend and commit_cadence_trend metrics are registered with permanently-Unavailable compute and risk silently blocking future real implementations due to existing id collision
Deleting timeout_s from signature restores natural parameter forwarding through **kwargs to the wrapped Jira client
test_trend_unavailable change-detector test pins placeholder metric stub behavior and should be removed alongside the stub metrics
